patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Opens Facebook directly on Marketplace and (optionally) hides the bottom tab bar. Built for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana).

options.description: Hides the Facebook tab bar (Feed / Reels / Watch / Notifications / Menu) so they aren't one tap away. Turn off to only change which tab opens at launch.
Disables swiping between tabs and the left-hand Facebook menu (hamburger button and edge swipe), so Reels, Groups, Dating etc. can't be reached from the main screen.
Never use Facebook's in-app WebView browser; every link opens in the default browser app.
Reels (and any other video opened in Facebook's fullscreen Watch/Reels viewer) can no longer be opened from feeds, profiles, deep links or notifications.
Back on Marketplace's root leaves the app instead of jumping to the Facebook Home feed.
Redirects every tab switch to Marketplace, including Facebook's "return to Home feed after being away" reset, so coming back to the app after a long time still shows Marketplace.
Pins Facebook's own Dark mode setting to "On" and makes the dark-theme decision points (is-dark check, theme application, FDS resolver) always dark, regardless of the system theme.
Removes the "Recommended groups" block on Marketplace search and the "Related groups" block on listing pages (Facebook's GYSJ units) by switching their MobileConfig flags off.
Removes the "Search in all of Facebook" and "Search with Meta AI" entries from Marketplace search, and blocks every other way into Facebook global search (e.g. profile > More options > Search).
Removes the paragraph with the "Go to settings" link on the Marketplace profile screen.
Adds an "About" row to the list that opens from the top-right account button on Marketplace. It opens a dialog describing this app.

patches.name: Marketplace rename
patches.description: Changes the package name to io.focalpoint.prism, the app name to Marketplace and the launcher icon to a storefront (all configurable), so the patched app installs next to the stock Facebook app. Uses the "Clone app" patch for the package name.

options.description: Package name of the patched app. Must be unique on the device.
Name shown under the launcher icon and in the system app list.
Replaces the launcher icon with the bundled Marketplace storefront icon.

release_notes: Morphe patch bundle for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54. Import the .mpp into Morphe.
repoDescription: Doing Meta's job for them. Facebook marketplace completely separate from Facebook itself.
